source.exact_title: Switch to once-weekly, single-tablet islatravir–lenacapavir from daily standard of care for HIV-1 (ISLEND-2): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, active-controlled, phase 3 non-inferiority trial
source.source_type: Randomised, open-label, active-controlled, phase 3 non-inferiority trial

limitations: No companion material was listed or supplied for this task.

The article repeatedly refers to an online appendix containing full eligibility criteria, protocol, statistical analysis plan, and additional analyses; that appendix was not listed as a companion source and was not used to fill details absent from the primary PDF.
No web copy was substituted for the Google Drive primary PDF.
Atoms were extracted from the primary report only; cited studies in the bibliography were not atomized as primary-study evidence.
